cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only passing the meeting details on, but nobody received my email. I'll put everything on hold; communication here has broken down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You forgot to send it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And nobody noticed. I'll introduce a second check before any office message goes out; the whole system can't depend on my memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it. Go and have your lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're covering communications in my absence. I'll name a deputy for you before I go; we need a succession plan, not just a sandwich break.

reason: Replace generic S06 tags with modest participation and actual outcome choices, keeping the precise Drive and B responsive contributions. Perform a further saved-dialogue reread before writer readiness.
